# Performance Planning Skill

Build the plan from normalized performance requirements, workload model, approved transactions and environment contract.

Never invent endpoints, workload, thresholds, credentials or abort limits.

The plan must identify:
- test objective
- scenarios
- workload model
- transaction mix
- duration
- environment
- entry criteria
- abort conditions
- evidence required
- engine selection

Approval is a separate human governance step. Do not create a second approval mechanism.
